title: mdBook configuration
description: The site's book.toml. mdBook reads more keys than these, so other keys are allowed; these are the ones an edit usually touches, and the two tables the Slipway adapter needs.

book.description: The book's title, language, and source folder.

authors.description: The people who wrote the book, as the page footer shows them.

description.description: One sentence about the book, used for its metadata.

language.description: The book's language as a tag such as en or fa-IR.

src.description: The folder holding the Markdown chapters, relative to book.toml. Default: src.

text-direction.description: The direction the pages lay out text in; rtl for Persian, Arabic, or Hebrew.

title.description: The book's title, shown in the sidebar and the page titles.

build.description: Where and how mdBook builds the book.

build-dir.description: The folder mdBook writes, relative to book.toml. Default: book. With the Slipway renderer the HTML lands in its html subfolder, book/html.

create-missing.description: Whether mdBook creates a chapter file that SUMMARY.md names and the source folder does not have.

extra-watch-dirs.description: Folders outside the source folder that mdbook serve watches for changes.

use-default-preprocessors.description: Whether the built-in links and index preprocessors run before the Slipway preprocessor.

output.description: One table per renderer. The Slipway adapter adds slipway.

html.description: The built-in HTML renderer: theme, search, and the address the book is served at.

slipway.description: The Slipway renderer's table; it needs the command that starts src/render.mjs.

command.description: The command mdBook runs after the HTML renderer, such as node tools/slipway-mdbook/src/render.mjs.

preprocessor.description: One table per preprocessor. The Slipway adapter adds slipway.

slipway.description: The Slipway preprocessor's table; it needs the command that starts src/preprocess.mjs.

command.description: The command mdBook runs before rendering, such as node tools/slipway-mdbook/src/preprocess.mjs.

rust.description: Settings for the Rust code samples that mdbook test compiles.

edition.description: The Rust edition for code samples, such as 2021.
